basic_info.description: $60,000 reduction from original asking price..... Will not last long at this price. Welcome to your Penthouse in the Sky! This top-floor, end-unit condo offers the perfect blend of comfort, style & indoor-outdoor living. With 2 bedrooms & 2 full bathrooms, this bright and airy home with 9ft ceilings is flooded with natural light from three sides. The expansive 500+ sqft walk-out patio sets this home apart - an entertainer's dream and a rare retreat in the city, ideal for dining, lounging, and enjoying the expansive views above SOMA. The freshly painted interior features engineered bamboo flooring throughout & a cozy fireplace. The updated kitchen has high-end stainless steel appliances, a skylight, a breakfast bar, new countertops and a sleek new backsplash. The spacious primary bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom & two closets, offering both comfort and functionality. Both bathrooms have been thoughtfully updated w/ new floors, vanities, mirrors, and modern heaters. This home includes one-car parking with additional storage in a secure, well-maintained elevator building. 98 Walk & 100 Transit Score, . A rare opportunity to own a sanctuary with deeded outdoor space that is an extension of your home.
